description: Three previously unused open-access 2025 papers covering long-context tables, table reasoning training, and multimodal Graph-RAG.
reclassification_reason: The first isolated app.query_knowledge context gate found shared retrieval/structured-evidence gaps: multi-column table rows were truncated, an unnamed Table 1 could not be deterministically addressed, a formula was split across blocks, and a multimodal table row was partially parsed. This set is no longer an unseen confirmation set.
freeze_policy: Do not tune retrieval, parsing, or answer formatting against this set. Any failure discovered after retrieval or generation requires reclassification as development-regression and a new unseen set.
